npm.summary: Embeddable multi-method tip QR web component for streamers and creators. One <script> tag, zero dependencies, nothing leaves the browser. Deep-links to crypto (BIP-21) + PayPal, Cash App, Venmo, Ko-fi. No account, no custody, no fees.
Simulate total color blindness (achromatopsia / complete monochromacy) — collapse a color or an image to its WCAG luminance. Built on the OpticQuiz engine.

MCP server that lets an LLM (Claude, Cursor, etc.) see a color or an image the way a colorblind person does — recolors PNG/JPEG for protan/deutan/tritan. Built on the published OpticQuiz engine (Machado 2009).

Generate Ishihara-style pseudoisochromatic color-vision test plates — a digit hidden in a dot field that collapses under protanopia, deuteranopia, or tritanopia. Reproducible from a seed. Built on the OpticQuiz engine (Machado 2009 + CIEDE2000).
Is your palette colorblind-safe? Check and fix color palettes for color-vision deficiency (protan, deutan, tritan) with the published OpticQuiz engine — Machado 2009 + CIEDE2000.

MCP server that lets an LLM (Claude, Cursor, etc.) check whether a palette OR an image is colorblind-safe, simulate color-vision deficiency, and check WCAG contrast — built on the published OpticQuiz engine (Machado 2009 + CIEDE2000).

See a color, a palette, or a whole image as a colorblind person does. Recolors PNG/JPEG for protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia — built on the published OpticQuiz engine (Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes 2009).
Simulate deuteranopia (green-blind) color vision — a typed shortcut over cvdsim / the OpticQuiz engine (Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes 2009).
Simulate the three dichromacies — protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia — for a color or a whole image. Umbrella over cvdsim / the OpticQuiz engine (Machado 2009).
Send, request and check Dogecoin from your terminal. Resolves @handles through public DNS, renders a scannable QR, and watches the chain. Holds no keys and never moves money — your own wallet signs.
Read guitar tablature and convert notes: eight tunings, capo offsets, MIDI and frequency. The same reader the Key-J browser app runs, lifted from it so the two cannot disagree.
Convert between visual-acuity notations: logMAR, Snellen (20/x or 6/x), and decimal. Pure arithmetic, no dependencies.
Color accessibility engine. Checks palettes for colorblind-safety (protan/deutan/tritan, Machado 2009, scored with CIEDE2000), fixes failing palettes, and checks WCAG contrast. Zero dependencies.
MCP server exposing the OpticQuiz color-accessibility engine as callable tools for LLMs (Claude, Cursor, etc.): colorblind-safe palette checks, color simulation, and WCAG contrast.
One-line colorblind accessibility widget: a floating eye that lets visitors re-color your page (daltonization) for their type of color-vision deficiency. Zero dependencies, zero tracking, SSR-safe.
Simulate protanopia (red-blind) color vision — a typed shortcut over cvdsim / the OpticQuiz engine (Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes 2009).
Generate, check, and fix colorblind-safe color palettes — protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia. Built on the published OpticQuiz engine (Machado 2009 + CIEDE2000) with the Okabe-Ito safe palette.
Normal (three-cone) color vision and anomalous trichromacy (protanomaly/deuteranomaly/tritanomaly) — the mild, partial deficiency. Built on cvdsim / the OpticQuiz engine.
Simulate tritanopia (blue-yellow) color vision — a typed shortcut over cvdsim / the OpticQuiz engine (Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes 2009).
